title: health/metadata-netflow.json
description: NetFlow plane board (Kind metadata). Health Telemetry visit only. Rewritten every NetFlow visit, quiet or not. Carries the lookup (bucket, measurement, window, exporters[]), last_visit_id (last stamp), last_collected_at (last completed collection), and the board: current[] last-known row per exporter and per conversation, series[] one estate metric row per visit, visits[]. Not the five-field envelope.

keys.description: Union of every key on current[].

datasource_uid.description: Grafana InfluxDB datasource uid when an operator pinned one; null means the tool default.

measurement.description: Flow measurement inside the bucket, discovered or operator-set.

window.description: timerange passed to grafana_query_influx every visit. Default 1h. An operator may set it; the nurse does not change it.

last_visit_id.description: watch_id of the last stamp written. Unchanged on a quiet visit.

last_collected_at.description: checked_at of the last completed collection, stamp or not.

source.description: Exporter address as tagged on the flow rows.

exporter_name.description: exporter_name tag as returned (unmapped is a value).

device.description: inventory/prod.json device name this exporter resolves to. Null when unresolved; the nurse does not guess.

exporters.description: Every exporter address seen. Resolved on the baseline (grafana_influx_schema) and again only when an F1 source is not listed here.

current.description: Last-known row per exporter and per conversation. A visit replaces every row it measured; exporters and conversations it did not see are carried as silent / absent.

series.description: One estate row per visit, oldest first.

row.description: Same shape as a stamp reading, without note. Exporter rows and conversation rows share the shape; conversation-only columns are null on an exporter row.

scope.description: exporter:<source> or flow:<source>/<src>><dst>:<dst_port>/<protocol>. Stable key for the board diff.

device.description: Exporter rows: the resolved device. Null on conversation rows (use exporter).

exporter.description: Conversation rows: the exporter's resolved device, else null.

src_device.description: Inventory device whose interface cidr or access host matches src. Null when unresolved.

dst_device.description: Inventory device whose interface cidr or access host matches dst. Null when unresolved.

keys.description: device:<device> / device:<exporter> / device:<src_device> / device:<dst_device> when resolved; site:<exporter_site> on exporter rows when tagged. Never an application or a port.

at.description: checked_at of the visit that last measured or carried this row.

state.description: Exporter rows: reporting / silent. Conversation rows: present / absent.

last_flow_at.description: Exporter rows: newest flow time seen from this source.

last_seen_at.description: Conversation rows: newest flow time for this pair.
